title: fix_signal output exceeds inline limit requiring external Read tool
description: mcp__moeb__fix_signal returns ~117K characters, exceeding the inline tool result limit in Claude Code MCP mode. The assistant must use the external Read tool to access the saved output file, triggering a moeb-tool-origin failure on every invocation. ToolSearch calls for deferred schema loading also generate unavoidable external tool use.
proposed_resolution: Reduce fix_signal prompt size by deduplicating the workflow content that appears twice (the Workflow section and the pre-loaded README section both contain the full skill). Also investigate eager schema registration to eliminate ToolSearch bootstrapping.
resolution_summary: Superseded by a1000063: consolidated prompt/README audit and MCP result overflow signal.
